title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園
summary: 濱海灣金沙空中花園是長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m 的鋼構平台，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三座 55 層混凝土塔樓，並在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m。課程從三塔相對變位與懸臂人致振動出發，處理鋼箱梁與後拉預力、塔頂 V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承、1,270 t 箱梁以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m、塔樓斜腿的施工控制，再談提升監測、阻尼器驗收、無邊際泳池接縫調平與長期徐變維護。
summaryEn: The Marina Bay Sands SkyPark is a steel platform about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide that bridges three 55-storey concrete towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower. The course starts from relative tower movement and crowd-induced vibration of the cantilever, then covers box girders and post-tensioning, rooftop V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings, strand-jack lifting of a 1,270 t girder pair to about 200 m and construction control of the leaning tower legs, before turning to lift monitoring, damper acceptance, infinity-pool joints and levelling, and long-term creep and maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算懸臂箱梁提升所需的鋼絞線數與提升時間。提升件為一對約 80 m 長的箱梁，假設重 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。選用 15.7 mm 鋼絞線，最小破斷力 279 kN，要求安全係數 2.5：所需根數 n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根，以 4 台千斤頂分配每台 28 根。提升高度 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間 t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h。若高空風速 15 m/s，箱梁迎風面 80 m × 10 m、阻力係數 2.0，橫向風力約 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN，約為吊重的 1.8%，鋼絞線偏角約 atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°。若安全係數改為 3.0，需約 134 根，每台 34 根；若風速增為 20 m/s，風力約 392 kN，偏角約 1.8°。所有數值為教學假設，不代表濱海灣金沙的實際提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the strands and lifting time for the cantilever box-girder lift. The load is a pair of box girders about 80 m long, assumed to weigh 1,270 t, F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. Using 15.7 mm strand with a 279 kN minimum breaking load and a safety factor of 2.5, the number of strands is n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112, or 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting. At a wind speed of 15 m/s at height, with an 80 m × 10 m frontal area and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is about 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN, about 1.8% of the weight, giving a strand inclination of about atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°. A safety factor of 3.0 needs about 134 strands, 34 per jack; a 20 m/s wind gives about 392 kN and an inclination of about 1.8°. All values are teaching assumptions, not the actual lifting design at Marina Bay Sands.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」與「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A platform spanning three independent towers" and "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三塔相對變位」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative movement of three towers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。若把平台與三塔剛接，塔樓的相對位移會在平台中產生巨大附加內力，也會把一座塔的側向力拉到另一座塔。因此平台在各塔頂以斜撐與可滑動支承落座，塔與塔之間的跨段設伸縮接縫，讓每座塔可獨立變位，平台只傳遞重力與必要的水平約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三塔相對變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. Rigidly connecting the platform to all three would induce large additional forces in the platform from relative tower movement and pull lateral load from one tower into another. The platform therefore sits on raking struts and sliding bearings at each tower top, with movement joints in the spans between towers, so that each tower moves independently and the platform transfers gravity and only the necessary horizontal restraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Relative movement of three towers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三塔相對變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Relative movement of three towers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers
knowledge.text: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。若把平台與三塔剛接，塔樓的相對位移會在平台中產生巨大附加內力，也會把一座塔的側向力拉到另一座塔。
knowledge.textEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. Rigidly connecting the platform to all three would induce large additional forces in the platform from relative tower movement and pull lateral load from one tower into another.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A platform spanning three independent towers" is correct?
options: 三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。
空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。
鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
optionsEn: All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep.
If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
quiz.explanation: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三塔相對變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative movement of three towers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。另計鋼平台本身溫度變形：α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 340 m、ΔT = 20°C，ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm。接縫與支承須同時容納兩者。溫差與兩塔反相假設為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. The steel platform's own thermal movement adds ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm for α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, L = 340 m and ΔT = 20°C. Joints and bearings must accommodate both. The temperature range and out-of-phase sway are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。另計鋼平台本身溫度變形：α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 340 m、ΔT = 20°C，ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm。接縫與支承須同時容納兩者。溫差與兩塔反相假設為教學假設。

The steel platform's own thermal movement adds ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm for α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, L = 340 m and ΔT = 20°C. Joints and bearings must accommodate both. The temperature range and out-of-phase sway are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A platform spanning three independent towers", which statement holds?
options: 滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。
兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。
optionsEn: Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm.
quiz.explanation: 兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三塔相對變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative movement of three towers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接縫與支承的設計行程要列出各分量（風、溫度、徐變、施工誤差）與組合方式，並在圖說上標示每個支承的約束方向；任何後續在平台上增設的固定物都不得跨越接縫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the design travel of joints and bearings by component (wind, temperature, creep, construction tolerance) and combination method, and mark the restrained directions of each bearing on the drawings; nothing added to the platform later may bridge across a joint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接縫與支承的設計行程要列出各分量（風、溫度、徐變、施工誤差）與組合方式，並在圖說上標示每個支承的約束方向；任何後續在平台上增設的固定物都不得跨越接縫。
knowledge.textEn: State the design travel of joints and bearings by component (wind, temperature, creep, construction tolerance) and combination method, and mark the restrained directions of each bearing on the drawings; nothing added to the platform later may bridge across a joint.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A platform spanning three independent towers"?
options: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。
optionsEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “66.5 m cantilever tip” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。若 δ = 60 mm，f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz，正落在步行頻率範圍；若加大勁度使 δ = 30 mm，f ≈ 2.9 Hz，已高於多數步行頻率，但仍可能被跳躍激發。撓度值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection. With δ = 60 mm, f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz, right in the walking range; stiffening to δ = 30 mm gives f ≈ 2.9 Hz, above most walking frequencies but still excitable by jumping. The deflections are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「66.5 m 懸臂端」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “66.5 m cantilever tip” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。深箱梁以高抗彎與抗扭勁度承擔長跨與懸臂，封閉斷面也讓偏心的人群與風荷載不致造成過大扭轉。後拉預力可以在吊裝完成後調整箱梁內力與撓度，抵消部分自重造成的上翼板拉力。跨越塔與塔之間的區段則由每段三榀約 400 噸的巨型桁架組成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide; published data give side walls about 35 mm and flanges about 60 mm thick, combined with post-tensioning. Deep boxes carry the long spans and cantilever with high bending and torsional stiffness, and the closed section keeps eccentric crowd and wind loads from causing excessive twist. Post-tensioning lets engineers adjust girder forces and deflection after erection, offsetting part of the top-flange tension from self-weight. The spans between towers use three mega-trusses of about 400 tons in each bridging section. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根箱梁慣性矩 I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴，斷面模數 Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³。若懸臂兩根箱梁共承受 w = 120 kN/m，根部彎矩 M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m，每根 132,700 kN·m，翼板應力 σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa。荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. If the two cantilever girders together carry w = 120 kN/m, the root moment is M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m, 132,700 kN·m per girder, giving a flange stress σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa. The load is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. If the two cantilever girders together carry w = 120 kN/m, the root moment is M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m, 132,700 kN·m per girder, giving a flange stress σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa. The load is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：箱梁圖說應標示人孔、檢修步道、通風或除濕設備與排水孔位置；後拉預力的錨具應設計為可檢查、必要時可重新張拉，張拉紀錄與標高量測一起歸檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Box-girder drawings should show manholes, inspection walkways, ventilation or dehumidification and drain holes; post-tensioning anchorages should be inspectable and re-stressable if needed, with stressing records filed together with level surveys.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。
knowledge.textEn: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.instruction: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。箱梁內部若無通風檢修，熱帶潮濕空氣凝結，內壁腐蝕長年不被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。在塔與塔之間的跨段端部，使用鋁板與不鏽鋼滑板組成的多向支承，讓平台能相對塔樓自由滑動與轉動，同時傳遞豎向反力。滑動面的摩擦係數決定了塔樓擺動時傳入平台的水平力，因此支承材料、表面光潔度與防塵防水細部，直接影響平台的受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls. At the ends of the spans between towers, multidirectional bearings with aluminium and stainless-steel sliding plates let the platform slide and rotate relative to the towers while carrying vertical reactions. The friction coefficient of the sliding surfaces sets the horizontal force fed into the platform when towers sway, so bearing materials, surface finish and dust and water protection directly affect platform forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。反力與摩擦係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design. Reaction and friction coefficients are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個支承應有標示牌與行程刻度，安裝紀錄記下溫度與偏移；維護計畫列明清潔、檢查與更換週期，支承更換所需的頂升點與臨時支撐在設計階段就要預留。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Each bearing should have a tag and a travel scale, with installation records stating temperature and offset; the maintenance plan should list cleaning, inspection and replacement intervals, and jacking points and temporary supports needed for bearing replacement should be provided at design stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strand-jack lifting to 200 m" and "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,270 t girder lift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台在地面或低處分成 14 個主要預製段，再以鋼絞線千斤頂吊上塔頂；最大一次提升是構成懸臂的一對約 80 m 長箱梁，重約 1,270 t，提升速度約每小時 14 m，耗時超過 16 小時。鋼絞線千斤頂以上下夾片交替夾持鋼絞線，像爬繩一樣一個行程一個行程地拉升重物，多台千斤頂由電腦同步控制。懸臂段另以可移動的門架安裝。整個工程用了約 4,000 t 臨時鋼結構，約為永久鋼結構 7,000 t 的一半以上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and raised to the tower tops by strand jacks; the largest lift was the pair of box girders about 80 m long that form the cantilever, weighing about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m per hour over more than 16 hours. A strand jack grips the strands alternately with upper and lower wedge anchors and climbs them stroke by stroke like a rope climber, with several jacks synchronised by computer. Cantilever segments were also placed with a movable gantry. The job used about 4,000 t of temporary steelwork, more than half of the 7,000 t of permanent steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1,270 t girder lift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The lift of 1,270 t is F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1,270 t girder lift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,270 t girder lift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：提升重量 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。若每根 15.7 mm 鋼絞線最小破斷力 279 kN、要求安全係數 2.5，需 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根鋼絞線，分配到 4 台千斤頂每台約 28 根。提升 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間約 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h，加上停檢與對位即超過 16 小時。鋼絞線規格與安全係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The lift of 1,270 t is F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. With 15.7 mm strands of 279 kN minimum breaking load and a required safety factor of 2.5, about 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 strands are needed, about 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes about 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting, exceeding 16 hours with hold checks and final alignment. Strand size and safety factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前完成千斤頂、鋼絞線、錨具與塔頂臨時提升架的設計核算與荷載試驗，並做離地試吊（提升數百毫米後停留觀察）；提升中監測各千斤頂荷載、行程與重物水平度，並記錄風速；到位後先臨時固定，經測量確認位置後才連接永久支承。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, complete design checks and load tests of jacks, strands, anchors and the temporary lifting frames on the tower tops, and do a trial lift that raises the load a few hundred millimetres and holds it for observation; during the lift monitor each jack's load, stroke and the levelness of the load and record wind speed; on arrival fix temporarily and connect to permanent bearings only after survey confirms position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With 15.7 mm strands of 279 kN minimum breaking load and a required safety factor of 2.5, about 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 strands are needed, about 28 per jack for 4 jacks. steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1,270 t girder lift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前完成千斤頂、鋼絞線、錨具與塔頂臨時提升架的設計核算與荷載試驗，並做離地試吊（提升數百毫米後停留觀察）；提升中監測各千斤頂荷載、行程與重物水平度，並記錄風速；到位後先臨時固定，經測量確認位置後才連接永久支承。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, complete design checks and load tests of jacks, strands, anchors and the temporary lifting frames on the tower tops, and do a trial lift that raises the load a few hundred millimetres and holds it for observation; during the lift monitor each jack's load, stroke and the levelness of the load and record wind speed; on arrival fix temporarily and connect to permanent bearings only after survey confirms position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 千斤頂不同步會使重物傾斜，荷載集中到少數鋼絞線與吊點，可能拉壞吊耳或局部屈曲箱梁；提升途中風速升高使重物擺動撞擊塔樓。臨時提升架若未考慮提升時的水平分力，可能在重物離地瞬間失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leaning tower legs and ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。施工期間斜腿在連結前無法自立，因此以臨時鋼支撐頂住，並以高強度鋼腱拉住；這些鋼腱原規劃為臨時，最後保留為永久。地面層以後拉預力基礎版承受斜腿產生的水平推力，並以預拱抵消自重造成的側向位移。Arup 預估塔樓的側向變形會持續約 30 年才趨於穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses. Before connection the inclined leg cannot stand alone, so it was propped by temporary steel struts and tied with high-tensile tendons, which were planned as temporary but finally kept as permanent. A post-tensioned slab at ground level resists the horizontal thrust from the inclined legs, and pre-camber offsets lateral displacement from self-weight. Arup expected the towers to keep deforming laterally for about 30 years before the movements converge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Leaning tower legs and ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leaning tower legs and ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。若以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線、每根工作力 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN 承擔，需約 72,800/167 ≈ 436 根；若傾角增為 25°，H ≈ 93.3 MN，需約 559 根。軸力與傾角為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN. Carried by 15.7 mm strands at a working force of 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN each, about 72,800/167 ≈ 436 strands are needed; at 25°, H ≈ 93.3 MN and about 559 strands. Axial force and angle are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升同步與風速監測」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。80 m 長的箱梁在高空懸吊時也像一面大風帆，橫向風力使重物擺動並在鋼絞線中產生不均勻張力。因此提升系統必須同時監測每台千斤頂的荷載與行程、重物兩端的高程差，以及現場與高空的風速，並以預先約定的門檻決定繼續、暫停或下降。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升同步與風速監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks; accumulated, they tilt the load and redistribute force. An 80 m girder hanging at height also acts like a large sail, so lateral wind makes it swing and loads the strands unevenly. The lifting system must therefore monitor each jack's load and stroke, the level difference between the ends of the load and wind speed at ground and at height, deciding to continue, pause or lower against thresholds agreed in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升同步與風速監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升同步與風速監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。風速 15 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa，迎風面 80 m × 10 m = 800 m²、阻力係數 2.0，橫向力 F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN。風速與阻力係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably. At 15 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa; with a frontal area of 80 m × 10 m = 800 m² and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN. Wind speed and drag coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升同步與風速監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 只監測千斤頂壓力而不量測重物高差，壓力感測器漂移時可能誤判同步；在午後雷雨前開始提升，突陣風讓懸吊箱梁擺盪撞擊塔樓立面或臨時架，造成構件與結構損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “4.5 t tuned mass damper” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸臂端的阻尼器是否有效，要在完工後以實測證明：先量環境振動求懸臂實際頻率與阻尼，再以有組織的人群步行、跑動或跳躍試驗，量測加速度並與舒適度限值比較。阻尼器必須調整到實際頻率，鎖定與釋放阻尼器各量一次可以直接看出它提供的附加阻尼。對觀景平台而言，豎向與扭轉模態都可能被偏心人群激發，量測點需包含懸臂端兩側。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whether the damper at the cantilever tip works must be proven by measurement after completion: first ambient vibration to identify the cantilever's actual frequency and damping, then organised crowd walking, running or jumping tests to measure acceleration against comfort limits. The damper must be tuned to the measured frequency, and measuring once with it locked and once released shows directly the added damping it provides. On a viewing deck both vertical and torsional modes can be excited by eccentric crowds, so measurement points must include both sides of the tip. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “4.5 t tuned mass damper” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “4.5 t tuned mass damper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。若懸臂頻率 f = 2.0 Hz、人群試驗中振幅 x = 3 mm，a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²；若阻尼器使振幅降為 1.5 mm，a ≈ 0.24 m/s²。頻率與振幅為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x. With a cantilever frequency f = 2.0 Hz and a 3 mm amplitude in a crowd test, a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²; if the damper halves the amplitude to 1.5 mm, a ≈ 0.24 m/s². Frequency and amplitudes are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “4.5 t tuned mass damper” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含阻尼器的調頻紀錄、鎖定與釋放試驗結果、可承受的人數與活動類型限制，以及阻尼器檢修週期；平台活動規劃須由營運單位依這些限制審核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the damper's tuning record, locked and released test results, permitted occupancy and activity limits and its maintenance interval; the operator must review event plans on the platform against these limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A damper shipped to the design frequency and not tuned on site loses much of its effect when the real frequency differs; tests with only a few walkers that omit synchronised jumping at large events reveal noticeable bouncing only after opening, at a party or event. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」與「塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement" and "Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pool joints and levelling jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位；池體下方以可調鋼千斤頂支承，在建築沉陷與變形後仍能調平。無邊際池緣要求整條溢流堰保持近乎水平，幾毫米的高差就會讓水集中從低處溢流，高處則乾涸露出堰頂。泳池同時是平台上最大的活荷載之一，滿水重量必須納入支承與箱梁設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers; adjustable steel jacks beneath the tanks allow re-levelling after building settlement and deformation. An infinity edge requires the whole weir to stay almost perfectly level: a few millimetres of difference make water spill mostly at the low point while the high part runs dry and exposes the weir. The pool is also one of the largest loads on the platform, and its full water weight must be included in bearing and girder design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pool joints and levelling jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pool joints and levelling jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pool joints and levelling jacks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。堰上水頭 h = 5 mm 時 q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m，146 m 堰全長約 95 L/s；若一端下沉 5 mm 使該端水頭變 10 mm，q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m，約為原值 2.8 倍，而另一端水頭趨近 0、堰頂乾涸。水頭與沉陷量為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m. With a head h = 5 mm, q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m, about 95 L/s along a 146 m weir; if one end settles 5 mm so its head becomes 10 mm, q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m there, about 2.8 times larger, while the head at the other end approaches 0 and the weir runs dry. Head and settlement are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term creep and bearing records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。熱帶海濱環境高溫、高濕與鹽霧，對鋼平台塗裝、滑動支承與泳池不鏽鋼都是考驗。交接文件必須記錄每個支承的初始偏移與行程、預力與調平紀錄、阻尼器參數與監測基準，讓營運者能判斷何時需要調整或更換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長期徐變與支承紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations. Handover documents must record each bearing's initial offset and travel, prestress and levelling records, damper parameters and monitoring baselines, so the operator can tell when adjustment or replacement is needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-term creep and bearing records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期徐變與支承紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term creep and bearing records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。取 δ∞ = 60 mm、τ = 8 年：第 10 年 δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm，第 30 年 δ ≈ 58.6 mm，剩餘不到 2 mm；若只預留 40 mm 行程，約第 9 年就會用完。δ∞ 與 τ 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)). With δ∞ = 60 mm and τ = 8 years, δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm at year 10 and δ ≈ 58.6 mm at year 30, less than 2 mm remaining; if only 40 mm of travel were provided it would be used up around year 9. δ∞ and τ are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期徐變與支承紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term creep and bearing records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含支承與接縫的初始偏移與行程表、徐變預測曲線、提升與預力紀錄、阻尼器調頻紀錄、泳池調平紀錄與監測資料格式；任何在平台上增加重量或改變用途的計畫，須先由結構顧問評估再核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include initial offset and travel tables for bearings and joints, the creep prediction curve, lifting and prestressing records, damper tuning records, pool levelling records and the monitoring data format; any plan that adds weight to the platform or changes its use must be assessed by the structural consultant before approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有初始偏移紀錄，營運者無法判斷支承目前用掉多少行程，直到支承頂到止擋、出現異音或接縫損壞才發現；塗裝破損未及時修補，高濕環境使鋼平台邊緣與排水處快速腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期徐變與支承紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term creep and bearing records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有初始偏移紀錄，營運者無法判斷支承目前用掉多少行程，直到支承頂到止擋、出現異音或接縫損壞才發現；塗裝破損未及時修補，高濕環境使鋼平台邊緣與排水處快速腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須記錄每個支承的初始偏移與行程、預力與調平紀錄、阻尼器參數與監測基準，讓營運者能判斷何時需要調整或更換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must record each bearing's initial offset and travel, prestress and levelling records, damper parameters and monitoring baselines, so the operator can tell when adjustment or replacement is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
